svg.aria-label: Boards and datasources come from Git, not from the UI: 1. Admin: ExternalSecret grafana-admin-secret pulls the admin user and password from 1Password item grafana. The chart reads them as existingSecret. 2. Boards: Chart downloads from grafana.com load into folders. Labelled ConfigMaps from kustomize (grafana_dashboard) load through the sidecar. 3. Datasources: Prometheus, Loki and Alertmanager are provisioned. Prometheus sets a 1 minute time interval to match its scrape interval. 4. Route: The HTTPRoute serves Grafana on envoy-internal only. Anonymous access is off, so every viewer signs in. 5. Render: A renderer pod draws panels to images for alerts and shares. Its NetworkPolicy admits CoreDNS replies so rendering can resolve names.
